Resurrection: The Return of the Black Dragon

name: Resurrection: The Return of the Black Dragon
storyline: In an epic fantasy land 3 warriors will have to join their forces in a quest to defeat a demonic god who hopes to resurrect the dreaded "black dragon" who will devour millions of souls and grant him infinite power.
summary: Resurrection is a combination of action and adventure game, facing a third-person fantasy set in reality, in which the three heroes must join forces to defeat a dangerous enemy. Made by Dinamic Multimedia. Availible only on PC.
